name: Benny Ibarra
description:
'''Benny Ibarra de Llano''' (born September 8, 1970) is a Mexican singer, musician, producer and actor. He was born into a family of artists. His mother, [[Julissa]], was a singer and actress in the 1960s; and his father, Benny, an actor and 1960s rock singer in the Mexican band Los Yaki. His brother, [[Alejandro Ibarra]], is a singer and actor.

Ibarra started his music career in the pop band [[Timbiriche]] (1981), and began working as a solo artist in 1992. He reunited with Timbiriche for the 1999 Reunion and again for the 25th Anniversary Tour in 2007- 2008. Between 2012-2016 he was part of the trio [[Sasha, Benny y Erik]], along with two other former members of the Mexican pop group Timbiriche, [[Sasha Sokol]] and [[Erik Rubin]]. In 2017, Benny joined the original founding members of Timbiriche to celebrate the 35th anniversary of the group.
